findings.note: Loftis voted Aye on second reading. HB 958, Election Law Changes (2025-2026 session). The bill digest (https://webservices.ncleg.gov/BillDigests/2025/H958) says it extends the time to provide photo ID after a provisional ballot cast without ID, requires overseas voters to submit a military-overseas ballot with a copy of photo ID or an affidavit, and allows voter registration at DMV and other agencies only if the applicant affirmatively states US citizenship.
subjects: proof of citizenship on voter registration
